[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/04/30 (Sun) 20:09  
[EVENT] User is planning to make chicken fajitas for dinner tonight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Chicken fajitas are a classic and delicious meal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Simple recipe for chicken fajitas includes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, 1/2 cup lime juice, 1/4 cup olive oil, 2 cloves garlic, 1 teaspoon dried oregano, 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin, 1/4 teaspoon paprika, salt and pepper, 1 large onion, 2 large bell peppers, 8 small flour tortillas, optional toppings: avocado, sour cream, salsa, shredded cheese, cilantro, lime wedges.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for chicken fajitas:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Prepare the vegetables by cooking sliced onions and bell peppers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Cook the chicken with the vegetables until cooked through.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Warm the tortillas in a damp paper towel.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Assemble the fajitas with chicken, vegetables, and toppings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Serve immediately.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips and variations include using any color bell pepper, adding heat with jalapeños, substituting chicken with beef or shrimp, and serving with toppings like diced tomatoes or shredded lettuce.  
[PREFERENCE] User thinks they will add onions and bell peppers to their grocery list and realized they are running low on olive oil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User's choices of fresh onions and bell peppers will elevate the flavor and texture of the chicken fajitas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should not forget to pick up olive oil as it is a staple in many recipes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for additional toppings include avocado, sour cream, salsa, and shredded cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fresh cilantro adds a nice burst of freshness and flavor to the dish.
